_note: Ground truth for evals (stage 9). Try not to read it before your agent has had a go.
question: Payments started failing around 14:00. What happened?
trigger: Campaign FLASH-OCT25 activated at 13:54:20 (orders.log), causing a traffic spike
root_cause: Gateway connection pool 'card-acquirer' exhausted (active=20/20, acquire timeouts after 5000 ms), surfacing as ERR-4012 in payments and 502 PAYMENT_FAILED in orders
red_herrings: ERR-4013 in payments.log (recovered on retry, unrelated)
suggested_action: Increase gateway.pool.card-acquirer.max from 20 to 50 and restart gateway instances one at a time; do not restart payments (runbook ERR-4012)
follow_up: Pool size was never changed; errors stopped only because campaign traffic dropped, so the problem will recur
